decisions.text: type stacked_bar_100: the fractions within each total, for an audience that objects to pies: 100 % stacked bars (D-39)
scale 0–100 by 20: each total 100 %, its parts in % of it (R7-30, G7.32)
nominal totals in their given order
the parts are ordered categories: stacked in their own order, the first at the base (G2.2)
the parts are ordered: steps of one hue, darker for each part from the last to the first, the first at the base; the palest steps, lighter than the gridlines, left out (G4.7, G3.2)
each part in one colour and one place in every total: Very high risk (step 9), High risk (step 8), Moderate risk (step 6), Low risk (step 5), Very low risk (step 3) (G4.22, G7.31)
labels as a set, 0 decimals, each with its “%” (owner, 1 Oct 2026): 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%
a horizontal scale of percentages: “%” on every label, and its title centred below, without “(%)” (owner, 1 Oct 2026): “% of portfolio, Dec. 31, 2022”
a legend row above the plot, below the title: the stacks' colours run left to right (G5.8, G5.10)
legend entries left to right, as the parts are stacked from the base: Very high risk, High risk, Moderate risk, Low risk, Very low risk, in 2 rows filled row by row (G5.8, R7-24)
